how: We read the website of every Atlanta wedding DJ listed on Lazo (54 listings, 49 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a national DJ chain's Atlanta page, AV and LED-wall production companies, a directory listing, and sites that were an unedited template or empty. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Who exactly will be at my wedding, and can I talk to that DJ before I sign?
For an outdoor ceremony in Georgia heat, what is your plan for power, shade for the gear and a rain move?
What is in the base price, and what are uplighting, photo booth and extra hours on top?

picks.name: Atlanta DJs Inc.
picks.blurb: Atlanta DJs keeps itself small on purpose so each event gets its attention, and points to its standing with clients, local venues and the Better Business Bureau. Laid-back vibe or a party that will not stop, with your questions answered before you book.

picks.name: Just In Time DJ/Entertainment (Atlanta)
picks.blurb: Patrick Thompson started Just In Time DJ in 2007 at 16, after noticing that the DJs at the catering events he worked were not into the guests. Now a full-service DJ, entertainment and production company in the Southeast, with Latin DJs on the roster and photo booths.

picks.name: Lethal Rhythms DJs
picks.blurb: Lethal Rhythms is Joel Rabe's Atlanta DJ company, with an individual page for each DJ featuring live music mixes, bios and equipment lists, plus LED dance floors. Weddings, corporate events and Bar and Bat Mitzvahs; the site lists its awards.

picks.name: Luma event professionals
picks.blurb: A husband-and-wife, family-owned entertainment company in Lilburn with bilingual and multicultural DJs and MCs, lighting, special effects and photo booths. DJs who read the crowd and keep the energy up all night is the promise.

picks.name: Goode Times Events
picks.blurb: Goode Times Events is an event coordinator and mobile DJ in one, based in Atlanta with formal events and weddings as its specialty. The team meets with you to go over your plans and vision before the day, and offers different experiences to suit the event.

picks.name: SE Events
picks.blurb: Since 1989 SE Events has run private events across Atlanta and the Southeast from a Norcross office, with wedding DJs, lighting, photo booths, videography and corporate AV under one roof. Reviews from previous customers are posted on the site.

picks.name: DJ Dre 1800
picks.blurb: Andre Peterson, an Indianapolis native in Atlanta for 27-plus years, DJs weddings, school dances and corporate parties out of Marietta, has hosted trivia for 8-plus years, and worked as audio technician for the Gwinnett Braves' 2009 inaugural season.

picks.name: Diamond Entertainment
picks.blurb: Diamond Entertainment pairs DJ and MC service with lighting, photo booths, live musicians and special effects, with a modern booth setup meant to complement the room rather than distract from it. Atlanta and surrounding areas.

picks.name: K&A Event Professionals LLC
picks.blurb: Juan and his team at K&A Event Professionals are a bilingual wedding DJ service in Stone Mountain that also does corporate, fashion and trade show events and runs a 360 video booth. The homepage leads with a couple's review about playing for a mixed crowd.

picks.name: One For The Books Entertainment
picks.blurb: DJ Perfect, Chuck, is a full-time mix DJ with over two decades behind the decks who has performed with Mr. Collipark, the Ying Yang Twins and Montell Jordan. One For The Books adds photo booths, lighting and rentals, with a polished modern setup.

picks.name: JAMMIN' DJs of Georgia
picks.blurb: Since 2007 JAMMIN' DJs has supplied DJs, MCs, photo booths and lighting across Georgia, Tennessee and Alabama, from wedding receptions to Bar and Bat Mitzvahs and school events. A full-time entertainment team based in Atlanta.

picks.name: Dj Cuttlefish | Atlanta Wedding + Event DJ
picks.blurb: DJ Cuttlefish is a team of Atlanta wedding and event DJs who spend their days researching popular and past music with the goal of making each party paramount. The point, in their words, is giving you and your guests the feels on the dance floor.
